item.title: Duluth East Boys Hockey Earns Massive Section Win By Taking Down Duluth Marshall
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth East boys hockey team picked up an upset victory over Duluth Marshall on Tuesday, 4-0. The Greyhounds were led by goaltender Nolan Nygaard, who stopped all 36 shots he saw. Duluth East finishes the regular season with a 8-15-2 record. Duluth Marshall falls to 19-4-2 on the year. Categories: High School, Sports

item.title: Proctor Girls Hoops Holds Off Mesabi East in Battle of First Place Teams
item.description: PROCTOR, Minn.- The Proctor girls basketball team continued their winning ways on Tuesday, defeating Mesabi East 64-57. The Rails improve to 17-5 and will next host Providence Academy on Saturday. As for Mesabi East (19-4), they’ll host Duluth Marshall on Thursday. Categories: High School, Sports
